notes.title: Ortharion : The Last Battle
notes.notes:
A new game has been in production for some time, you can find information about it as well as [b]add it to your wishlist[/b]:

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1777990/Ortharion__The_Last_Battle/]Ortharion : The Last Battle[/url]

The game is currently in the Pre-Alpha phase and will be in development for about 1 year before going into Early access, so late 2022 see early 2023.

[u]The game will be an improvement of Ortharion Project, here is a non-exhaustive list of additions or modifications that will be made:[/u]

[list]
[*] [b]Top quality[/b], I put it first in the list for reasons that I think are obvious, especially for those who have played Ortharion Project.

[*] [b]Land 4 times larger and more numerous than on Ortharion Project[/b], for a game size approximately 10 times greater than the current Ortharion Project.

[*] [b]Choices that have consequences[/b], allowing you or not to win "The Last Battle".

[*] [b]A ranking system between players[/b], "speed Run" and a game system with season and off season. There will therefore be aspects of multiplayer, but the game will not allow you to play several at the same time and the game can always be played without an internet connection.

[*] [b]An adventurer's guild management[/b], with a crafting system. You can ask certain adventurers to become your adventure companions.

[*] [b]A rethinking combat system[/b], some research allowed me to see that the type of movement, of camera management that I envision the most would be close to Elyon, on which I intend to be inspired.

[*] [b]Improved exploration[/b], with fog of war, of terrains using more verticality, with much larger interior areas, hidden areas to discover, puzzles requiring knowledge of the world.

[*] [b]A system of specialization further push[/b], Choose 7 subclasses from the 30 in total offered, with talent trees for each subclass for greater diversity.

[*][b] Added many new stats[/b] with Tier stats like on Path of Exile and a more advanced crafting system.
[/list]

Do not hesitate if you have any questions / suggestions, if you ever have something that you did not like about Ortharion Project that you would like to see completely rethought.

notes.title: 1.2a
notes.notes:
[u]Bug fix[/u]
[list]
[*] Improved player collisions to avoid the bug that causes loss of lives when falling.
[*] Changed the loot filter that takes into account saves and all changes.
[*] Added icon on "weapon of choice - Staff" spells as well as "spell book".
[/list]

A new version of Ortharion Project is in progress, but I will tell you about it when I have a more complete version than now.

[u]Some changes to the orientation of the game:[/u]

[list]
[*] The game on the combat / non-combat phase changes was too easy to exploit, the non-combat phases allowing for too much stamina as well as health and Mana regeneration, favoring a very aggressive approach and killing pack by pack. The goal instead is to give you the choice of how to play: pack by pack or always staying in combat so with builds more based on the ability to dodge, block or inflict large amounts of damage depending on the number enemies around you.

[*] The choice of builds was often oriented with 1 or 2 active skills then several buffs / aura / passive spells, the goal instead would be to make builds with several skills as strong as the builds that are played only with buffs.
[/list]

[h1]New content[/h1]

[list]
[*] Added loot filter and automatic loot pickup.
[*] Added 26 runes.
[*] Added 2 new talents, one of which allows you to use enhancement spells without the use of animation, so very profitable combined with auto-cast.
[*] The player can start the game in "lone wolf" mode in which case all of the player's progression systems are individual.
[*] Chests with better loot rewards are available but their openings also create monsters all around the player, there are usually 2 or 3 per land in random locations.
[*] The player can choose to run wave missions with a certain number of waves as well as determine the time between each monster call if the current wave is not totally destroyed.
[*] Addition of 9 achievements, including 2 related to the lone wolf game mode, these 2 specific achievements can only be performed in lone wolf mode but are beneficial to the entire account unlike other achievements earned in lone wolf game mode which will not benefit the rest of the account.
[/list]

[h1]Improvements[/h1]

[list]
[*] The player will lose the saves of those specific runes, which are categorized differently in the rune window, as several balance changes have been made.
[*] It is possible to let the dash spell press to relaunch it.
[*] Dungeons now earn additional gear and use the same interface as quest and mission rewards.
[*] It is possible to directly restart a mission, a dungeon or return to the camp after having done a mission or a dungeon.
[*] In wave missions it is not possible to have more than 50 monsters present at the same time, in this case the counter before the next wave pauses.
[*] Performance improvement when fighting with a lot of enemies, changes still need to be made.
[*] Change in the descriptions of the loading pages to give only interesting information.
[*] Allied NPCs find enemies to attack faster after they've just killed an enemy.
[*] Addition of a teleporter in the desert, it will necessarily be active for all characters.
[*] Spells that absolutely require a target are easier to use with near target recognition if you don't have a primary target.
[*] Weapons and equipment are sorted by subcategory from the inventory.
[*] Camera shakes can be removed from the options.
[*] The aiming zones on the ground remain visible if the player keeps the spell pressed.
[/list]

[h1]Balancing[/h1]

[u]Rune balances:[/u]

[list]
[*] Rune of non-sacrifice for the mana spell of sacrifice: energy used changed from -100% to -50%.
[*] Duration buff runes are available for spells that have a very short duration, such as invulnerability.
[*] Rune damage over time "Infinite" changed from 20 to 15 maximum stack.
[*] Normal Quality Time Damage Proc Rune: Changed from 100% to 50% proc damage.
[*] Rune of the Area Multiplier grants 50% area damage size instead of 2 yards.
[*] Improved Speed Rune: changed from + 10% to + 6% movement speed.
[/list]

[u]Spell balances-various :[/u]

[list]
[*] Second class bonuses now all have the same evolution system, so the number visible at level 1 will have the same progression factor at level 25.
[*] Elemental Shield: Maximum elemental and elemental defense increased from + 10% to + 8% maximum, damage absorption increased from 300 to 480.
[/list]

[u]Spell balances-nerf :[/u]

[list]
[*] Mana cost of spells while leveling up changed from + 16% to + 17%.
[*] The Unfazed: Regeneration out of combat at max level increased from + 120% to + 80%.
[*] Invulnerability: Resource cost + 120%, Cooldown: changed from 40 to 50 seconds, damage reduced by 80% instead of 100%. The goal is to make it not possible to have him 100% of the time active with 100% damage reduction.
[*] Shield of the Weak: Damage bonus increased from + 40% to + 32%.
[*] Improved speed: Resource cost + 25%, Cooldown changed from 30 to 25 seconds. Attack speed increased from 25% to 22.5% at max level, with level 1 not being hit.
[*] Progressive Power: Maximum stack increased from 8 to 6.
[*] Mana trance: level 1 with 1 stack causes a loss of 0.4 mana per second instead of 1, but causes a loss of 1.4 instead of 1 at maximum level and the spell is lost if the mana drops below 20% instead of 5% and works fine.
[*] Unison with the Forest:% Life regeneration and% Mana per second have been reduced by 50%.
[*] Sorcerer: The damage bonus at maximum level has been reduced from 36% to 8.4% per stack active on the player. The total damage bonus with a good build remains among the best you can get even after the nerf.
[*] Devastating Shock: Stun duration changed from 4 to 2 seconds.
[/list]

[u]Spell balances-up:[/u]

[list]
[*] Summon Blade no longer has a cast time.
[*] Rock Familiar, Cold Familiar, Summon Blade spells can be autocast.
[*] Quick Heal: Increased health gain at max level from 300 to 400, level 1 has not been hit.
[*] Lightning Shield: Damage + 40%.
[*] Lightning Familiar: Damage + 100%.
[*] Fire Familiar: Damage + 40%.
[*] Ice Familiar: Damage + 200%.
[*] Life Familiar: Damage + 40%.
[*] Lightning Turret: Damage + 40%.
[*] Offensive Turret: Damage + 50%.
[*] Lightning mine: Damage + 100%.
[*] Ice Mine: Damage + 40%.

[*] Masochist: Max level changed from +125% to +480% damage if your lives are close to 0%.
[*] Understanding of incantations: maximum stack increased from 3 to 5.
[*] Arcanist: Max level changed from + 3% to + 4.8% damage for resource cost.
[*] Sniper: Max level increased from + 10% damage to + 30% per meter of distance.
[*] Deep Laceration: Max level changed from + 100% damage to + 240% damage.
[*] Berzerker: Max level increased from + 42% to 72% damage per attack speed.
[*] Insanity: Increased maximum level from + 13.5% to + 21% damage per stack power of the enraged.
[*] Acrobat: Max level increased from + 1.2% to + 2.4% damage per available stamina, stamina regeneration increased from + 50% to + 20%.
[*] Tamer: Max level changed from + 100% to + 240% damage.
[/list]

[u]Balancing equipment:[/u]

[list]
[*] Improved Speed ​​Boot: Number of additional stacks increased from +3 to +2.
[*] Equipment: Resource cost reduction from + 23% on average at level 100 to + 19%.
[*] Gear: Cooldown reduction from + 23% on average at level 100 to + 16%.
[/list]

[u]Various balancing:[/u]

[list]
[*] The difference in Energy and Vitality stats has been reduced for class selection, for example, the maximum being 8 Energy for 6 Vitality instead of 4 Energy for 10 Vitality.
[*] Damage + 80% and life + 20% for level 1 monsters, the difference becomes less as you level up and is closer to + 0% at level 5.
[*] There is no longer a difference in stamina management when the player is in combat or out of combat. Base stamina at level 1 has been reduced by 20%, so it's an up for when the player is in combat and a nerf for non-combat phases. The number visible on the character description now actually matches what the player earns per second.
[*] Enemies have + 30% additional range to follow the player before they are inactive again.
[*] Granock Forest Mushrooms can be sold for 50 gold.
[/list]

[h1]Bug fix[/h1]

[u]Major bug:[/u]

[list]
[*] Dungeons from the camp are again correctly randomized.
[*] Mission rewards always have their entire slot with items to choose from.
[*] The mana trance spell is correctly removed when it drops below certain mana thresholds.
[*] The fiery aura talent for range increase is correctly accounted for.
[*] The passive class spell "tireless" correctly regenerates additional stamina.
[*] The bosses in the arena are not all calling at the same time and the map is correctly updating.
[*] The description and reduction of damage taken from bonus 4 of the Classic Attack Set are correctly taken into account.
[/list]

[u]Minor bug:[/u]

[list]
[*] Aura of debuff no longer has the debuff spell category so it doesn't have some unusable runes.
[*] The free zoom option is correctly saved.
[*] Player's lives and Mana are correctly set to 100% after adding achievement stats when creating characters.
[*] Casting multiple spells at the same time does not re-cast the last spell cast.
[*] Texture changes for Amazons in Mountain Brigands.
[*] Change in the descriptions of some talents.
[*] Correction of some texts.
[*] Spell leveling descriptions correctly take into account the resource cost.
[*] The quest tracking window on the right of the screen no longer closes between land loads.
[*] The description on the item comparison for the "damage reduction taken" statistic is calculated correctly.
[/list]

notes.title: 1.2 in progress
notes.notes:
1.2 is under development and should be released between the last week of June and the first week of July and here are the highlights what you'll find there. Other improvements will be added but you will discover all in patch 1.2.

[list]
[*] Added loot filter and added auto pickup option.
[*] The player can directly redo the missions or dungeon when he has finished an area.
[*] Missions may have factors defined by the player before starting.
[*] Chests protected by waves of monsters will be available randomly in several maps. Difficulty such as number of waves, number of monsters and type of monsters will not be disclosed to the player but will influence the rewards present in the chest.
[*] New runes will be added with more spell-specific runes. Spell-specific runes will be visible differently on the choice of spell runes and new runes will be added.
[*] A new mode of character creation: "Lone Wolf" which will allow you to create a character who will have his own chest and achievements. Achievements specific to this game mode will be created to benefit the rest of the account.
[*] The backups will be done locally and no longer on the registry editor, normally allowing the use of steam cloud and slightly improving load times. However, tests still need to be carried out before we can be sure of doing so.
[*] Improved aiming systems with individual target projectiles and spells.
[/list]

[*] The chances of having magic items during the missions become multiplying factors instead of additional ones, so the rewards of the missions on the higher level of difficulty will be more profitable and conversely the missions on the lower level of difficulty will give less rewards. Level 10 to 3 star before: + 310% goes to + 250%. Level 100 to 3 stars before: +550% goes to +750%.

notes.title: 1.1a bug fix
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] The target areas are correctly visible on all terrains.
[*] Mushrooms in the granock foret can be picked up properly.
[*] The price of Epic Runes and Gems is calculated correctly for purchase.
[/list]

[h1]New content[/h1]

[list]
[*] A new map has been added with a new game mode: Missions. This new system is available from the adventurer's camp, there are currently 3 types of missions.
[*] All spells are visible in the spellbook in several sections, and spell visibility has been redesigned.
[*] Spells can be purchased directly from the spell book. Qualifications must be met and prices vary, they are cheaper for evolution classes and for state spells.
[*] Added level bonuses for some spells, these bonus levels can be found on multiple locations, such as gems, gear, talent.
[*] Bonus levels on equipment are added in addition to powers and set. The chances of getting a bonus level depend on what is already on the equipment.
[*] Added 22 new talents, the talent tree has been reset.
[*] Added 9 gear spells.
[*] Added 14 runes.
[*] Added 16 gems.
[*] Added 9 new spells.
[*] Added 12 new achievements.
[*] A new item improvement interface is available, allowing you to change or add to your equipment spells, sets, bonus levels.
[*] The enchanter in the Mercenary Encampment can now change any stats that were not changed by the individual change.
[*] Added new stats: + X% Energy Shield regeneration.
[/list]

[h1]Improvements[/h1]

[u]Major improvements[/u]

[list]
[*] Improved slope detection as well as slip operation.
[*] The version of Unity that I am using has been updated, but requiring many changes, the HD version did not bring me anything other than the "Volumetric light" and some light adjustments so I am back on a standard version, allowing to have a better FPS, +10 to +20 depending on the levels, a better control of the visual options for you from the options.
[*] Spells can be autocast.
[*] Updates for interior terrain, several new rooms have been added or modified and dungeons are no longer procedural.
[*] The visuals for the following spells have been redone: Frost Shield, Frost Pillar, Frost Peak, Cold Shock, Ice Nova, Rock Peak, Fireball, Volcanic Eruption, Puddles for NPCs.
[/list]

[u]Performance improvements[/u]

[list]
[*] Enemy animations are no longer activated based on distance but whether they are visible or not.
[*] Improved performance for passive spells or runes with activation effects, such as 10% chance to inflict burn. This issue was easily seen during AoE attacks for high level characters.
[*] Improved performance on spell cooldowns.
[/list]

[u]Interface improvements[/u]

[list]
[*] On the parchment upgrade interface, when you create a new spell, the scrolls stay in the slot, avoiding having to replace them each time.
[*] If you have potions in your action bar and pick up new ones of the same category, they are added to your current stocks in your action bar.
[*] From the map window you can click on the orange dots to see the other maps.
[*] Spell Scrolls as well as Blank Scrolls can be sold.
[*] Changed the description of the spell "Buff aura" for the bard to make the description easier to understand.
[*] If you change equipment and the spellbook is open, your spell visualization is updated.
[*] The level as well as the bonus level are visible on the spell information if they are above level 0.
[*] Changed the icons of the burst and elemental shield spells.
[*] The spellbook has had a change in the visibility of these spells.
[*] When the chest is full and the player tries to send an item that has a stacking number and an item of the same type is present, it is possible to accumulate both in the chest.
[*] It is possible to reset talent points for gold.
[*] The player can remove runes from spells without needing to change them to other runes.
[/list]

[u]Various improvements[/u]

[list]
[*] If the player dies falling into a void or water in hardcore mode death is not counted and the player remains in hardcore mode.
[*] The red screen of life is more easily seen when the player has lost more than 50% of those health points.
[*] Enemies are correctly removed 3 seconds after they die.
[*] It is no longer possible to zoom in as much as before, to avoid problems with aiming.
[*] The rune number visible at the top of the rune interface updates when you pick up or purchase a rune while the interface is open.
[/list]

[u]Sound improvements[/u]

[list]
[*] There is no longer an overlap of multiple sounds at the same time on melee attacks.
[*] The aura of fire has no sound anymore.
[*] The player's damage-taking sounds are heard when damage is greater than 10% instead of 5%.
[*] The number of sounds of finished objectives and finished quests have been reduced to keep only the 2 most consistent.
[*] The sounds of the teleporter and resurrection pylons are heard less far and less loudly.
[/list]

[h1]Balancing[/h1]

[u]Spells balances:[/u]

[list]
[*] Passive bonuses, talent, and gems that increased energy shield gain approximately 25% bonus.
[*] Spells no longer have an orientation speed limit.
[*] The second animation of classic attacks such as slash is faster.
[*] Slash can be used with a staff.
[*] The shield attack animations and the animation for the decapitation spell have a faster transition.
[*] Reduced the damage of Dot that has a low duration, -25% overall and -75% for burn for level 1 and -40% at level 25.
[*] The Dash no longer has a learning condition, if you use a spell at the same time, it stops its execution, but without triggering its cooldown, when you exit your Dash phase your running speed is at its maximum , the distance traveled has been reduced by 10%.
[*] "Weakening" spell changed from -7.5% to -4.2% damage dealt by enemies at maximum levels per stack.
[*] Changed the shaman's elemental debuff that deals additional damage based on the number of "weakening" present on the target.
[*] Breath of Death no longer uses a use condition.
[*] The Summon Mage Skeleton spell costs 19% more mana.
[*] Lightning Strike requires 0.5 cast time instead of 0.7 and has the "Spell" category.
[*] Coldstroke takes 0.3 cast time instead of 0, mana cost has been reduced by 10%.
[*] The passive spell "Activate by block" activates "infinite block" instead of "progressive resistance"
[*] Flame Storm: Rotation speed changed from 0% to 100%, movement speed changed from 40% to 50%.
[*] “Regeneration Enhancement” now has the Aura spell category.
[/list]

[u]Rune balances:[/u]

[list]
[*] You have a 200% chance to get a rune that you don't already have by loot or random rune purchase.
[*] The Area Multiplier rune is only available for direct damage area spells.
[*] The rare rune that has a 30% chance to apply slow poison can be used on projectiles in addition to area spells.
[*] Random runes can be directly purchased on different rarities and the prices are now fixed and based on rarity.
[/list]

[u]Talent balances:[/u]

[list]

notes.title: 1.1 in progress
notes.notes:
Version 1.1 has been in progress for almost a month now and a lot of work remains to be done, [b]1.1 will be after February, probably end of March[/b].
Here's a preview of what you'll see:

[h3]New visuals and new lights[/h3]

I am using a new version of software and rendering, allowing to improve performance, use more assets that were not compatible with the versions and renderings that I was using before, but all of the renderings had to be redone for the game, asking me a lot of work but which should save me later, because less bugs on my software, less compilation time for debugs, less problems technical because easier to use, it should also allow access to visual rendering options.

[h3]Change on terrain[/h3]

Procedural dungeons have been removed, leaving room for non-procedural areas, areas are larger, with new rooms, old rooms have been upgraded, shadows have been improved, there will be no more enemies under the ground nor inactive enemy, with a great performance improvement on the graphics card.

[h1]Adventurer missions[/h1]

A new terrain is available, designed for a new game mode: Adventurer missions, you will have missions promoting the creation of certain builds, with a dedicated progression system.
This is what this new terrain looks like, with the new light rendering due to the version change:

[url=https://ibb.co/VDZbqDj][img]https://i.ibb.co/zbYC4bn/Nouveau-terrain-1-1.png[/img][/url]

The missions currently under test are:

[list]
[*] Kill a maximum of enemies in 5 minutes.
[*] Destroy structures defended by enemies.
[*] Protect structure.
[*] Protect turrets.
[/list]

The more you perform, the more you will be rewarded.
These 4 categories don't stop there, enemies can have behavior modifiers such as only attacking structures, turrets can benefit from your healing and aura enhancement, areas to protect can be scattered around the map , the higher your level of adventurer, the more it will be necessary to specialize.

[h1]Various improvement[/h1]

In addition to these three main changes which are already finished many other changes will emerge, thank you to everyone who gave me their feedback on the Steam Community.
Here is a list of some changes that I wanted to share with you but the list doesn't end there:

[list]
[*] A new NPC, create the equipment of your dreams, the more the number of specifical stats you want, the more the amount requested will be.
[*] The Rune Vendor will sell you runes you don't have, depending on the rarity you want.
[*] The Scroll Vendor may sell you random scrolls specific to your class, or one of your evolutions.
[*] Unlocking a new class will give you the spells corresponding to the class.
[*] Added specific Lightning, Nature, and Physical talent and other one.
[*] Have the possibility to withdraw talent points.
[*] New consumables, such as increased item level or repaired durability.
[*] Have blocking-based builds, with an "unblockable / blockable" character state, added shield category with very fast small shields wich can block less damage, and slower shields wich can block more damage .
[*] Having builds based on the energy shield, therefore with a character state "on recharge / recharged" bringing new possibilities.
[*] New mana management: A stable state that you already know, a "out of mana" state and finally an "overload" state where your mana overflows you and increases less easily.
[/list]

As explained above this is only a part of the new content, new legendary runes, spells and gear will also be added.

On top of that I have a [b]list of 85 quality of life / bugs / changes to make[/b] the game more polish than it is currently.

Have fun

notes.title: 0.8.7b - Improvement
notes.notes:
This update mainly adds fluidity in combat and improves some visible information.

The 0.8.8 which will be the next update will make the special attacks of monsters more visible and they will inflict much more damage. Currently the special attacks of enemies can be confused with their classic attacks, which will no longer be the case.
New types of attacks will also be created, mainly for arena bosses.
After 0.8.8 all updates will be to improve the current state of the game up to 1.0.

[u]Improvement[/u]

[list]
[*] Skills that are not spells no longer use a cast.
[*] The level of difficulty is constantly visible with the name of the terrain.
[*] Spells are cast directly if they have 0.1s or less time cast.
[*] Several spells that had less than 0.5 seconds of cast time are cast directly.
[*] The spells : Powerful blow, devastating shock and decapitation have their animations changed.
[*] Health points, mana and level are no longer visible on non-living objects (dungeon door, chest, parchment table).
[*] Movement animations are no longer reset at the start of each attack, which makes everything visually smoother.
[*] Added a new category of spells: classic attack. Spells that use this category are Rapid Fire, Slash, Magic Missile, Lightning Slash.
[*] The camera continues to get closer if it comes in contact with a wall even after reaching the limit defined by the minimum zoom and the player is no longer visible if the distance is less than 1 meter.
[*] You can no longer teleport if you are dead or if you have completed a dungeon.
[*] Several state-type spells can no longer be put in the action bar, knowing that the information is visually present on the spells: Understanding of incantations, progressive power, progressive resistance, power of the enraged, power of the elements, unison with forest, all damage over time status spells and all decrease spells.
[*] Better handling of monster aggro, which will also slightly improve FPS and slightly reduce lag when loading new terrain.
[*] Cast speed is now called cast time reduction, Cooldown is called cooldown reduction, Resource cost is now called resource cost reduction and therefore have positive progression values ​​which will prevent confusions.
[*] The character window correctly shows stats with 0% base bonus instead of 100%.
[/list]

[u]Balancing[/u]

[list]
[*] The ambidexterous passive spell also grants 10% attack speed bonus and 5% parry chance if you are equipped with 2 weapons, the damage bonus increased from 30% to 20% total.
[*] The spell "Power" has a 40 second cooldown instead of 20 seconds, the spell is now a rare rarity spell, it correctly gains bonus damage and not power.
[*] Improved Speed ​​Enhancement Spell: Increased base attack speed bonus from 10% to 15%, and max level increased from 30% to 25%.
[*] Rank-up of spells becomes easier, fewer scrolls are needed.
[*] Clay Armor changed from normal to magical rarity.
[*] Shield of Absorption changed from magical rarity to normal.
[*] Improved Defense changed from normal to magical rarity.
[*] Slow Poison changed from magical rarity to normal, and increased its maximum duration from 16 to 12 seconds.
[*] Player cooldown reduction no longer applies to item spells or talent.
[*] Spell comprehension casting speed reduction has been improved from 24% to 45% reduction for the maximum level.
[/list]

[u]Bug fix[/u]

[list]
[*] Added some collisions on some 3D models.
[*] If you don't have spells, your equipment no longer adds the spell to you at level 0 (such as progressive power with weapons). This fixes the boost speed bug which was not retreating correctly and increased attack speed enormously.
[*] Damage from blade summons is correctly visible on the tooltip.
[/list]

[*][b]Leave as many action choices as possible[/b], collect hidden chests, solve puzzles to access certain secret passages, do quests, make specific achivment and of course kill monsters as well as confront powerful bosses. All these small elements to evolve the stats of the character.
